title: Fullmoon module registry
description: Module catalog data rendered by modules.fullmoon.ink. Registration PRs must satisfy this schema; scripts/validate-registry.mjs (CI) enforces the same rules. verified must be false in registration PRs - only the operator flips it to true after review.

name.description: Display name shown in the catalog.

type.description: bot=Discord bot, dashboard=web dashboard, tool=other tool, client=Minecraft client/launcher.

description.description: One-line intro - what it shows. Public copy: friendly haeyo-che.

url.description: Discord bot invite, website, or public repo. https only - spam links are rejected.

source.description: Where the module's code lives (public repo). Optional in the schema but strongly recommended for bots/tools - the operator reviews it before merging.

addedAt.description: Registration date, YYYY-MM-DD, must be a real calendar day.

verified.description: false in a registration PR. The operator sets true after checking real traffic and rule compliance; validate-registry.mjs enforces the false-only rule in pull_request CI runs.
